messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: Smart-routing anomaly detected for prod cluster us-west-2. Elevated error-rate + fallback thrashing. Root alert at 2487659999.

sarah: seeing 502 spikes and token latency up ~3x for a handful of high-traffic customers. Traffic keeps failing over between us-west-2 and eu-west-1 every ~30s.

michael: pager received. I'm on it, pulling logs from router and config-service.

carol: adding context — we shipped a config-schema change in config-service earlier today that removed the old `variant_preference` key (deprecated) and introduced `preferred_variant`. Risk flagged but allowed compatibility-mode.

michael: confirmed. Recent routing decisions show policy lookup returned default policy because the new validator dropped unknown `variant_preference`. Default contains `fallback: choose-region` and `variant: autoscale-latest` which picks a quantized variant that isn't available in the primary region. That triggers immediate regional fallback.

tom: TL;DR: config change made old field ignored -> routing policy fell back to a default that points to an unavailable variant -> runtime routes to other region -> capacity in target alternates and triggers fallback loop.

emily: customer impact: list shows ~43k requests last 10m affected, error ratio 8% (baseline 0.3%). One enterprise customer (acct AC-998) reported timeouts and opened a support ticket.

infra-bot: deploy-log: config-service v3.12.0 -> schema-validator: removed `variant_preference` alias at 2487656000. Canary passed. No rollback.

michael: paging sequence: I'm going to escalate to oncall SRE @tom for regional mitigation. tom, want to take primary?

@tom: taking primary. I'll freeze routing decisions to disable the new default fallback temporarily and pin the model variant to `model-v2-legacy` for affected routes.

carol: recommend patch: schema-validator should accept `variant_preference` and translate to `preferred_variant` for compatibility. We should also add a safe default variant that is available across regions, not a region-specific quantized one.

sarah: mitigation plan steps: 1) Add temporary override in routing-service to pin `preferred_variant` for affected customers 2) Roll forward quick schema patch to reintroduce alias 3) Rollback config-service change if patch takes >20m 4) Monitor for oscillation.

michael: executing step 1: applying routing override for customers in the affected cohort. Command:``` 
# temp pin
curl -XPOST https://routes.internal/api/overrides -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"scope":"acct:AC-*","preferred_variant":"model-v2-legacy","expires":"2487661200"}'
```

infra-bot: override accepted, id=ovr-20240315-73. Changes propagated to edge routers in 12s.

tom: building quick schema patch. I'll push a validator patch that re-adds alias mapping and rejects schema changes that drop deprecated keys without explicit migration. Preparing a canary.

carol: while tom prepares, can we temporarily disable cross-region fallback for the routing-tier? That will stop the oscillation. It may increase local errors but avoid thrash.\

dave: I'll flip the `region-fallback.enabled` flag to false for the smart-router group handling these customers. Command:``` 
# disable cross-region fallback
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/smart-router REGION_FALLBACK=false --record
```

infra-bot: region-fallback=false applied to 3 replicas. Rolling update in progress.

emily: monitoring: errors drop from 8% -> 3.2% after override + region-fallback=false. Latency back to ~1.4x baseline. Still above normal but stable.

michael: tom, status on validator patch?

@tom: patch built, unit tests pass. Pushing canary to one config-service replica. Command: `deploy config-service v3.12.1-canary`

infra-bot: canary deploy started. Health checks pending.

carol: also pushing quick change to the default fallback in config repo: set `fallback_variant: model-v2-legacy` instead of autoscale-latest. This prevents selecting region-only quantized models.

emily: metrics: canary + override + region flag: error rate down to 1.0%, latency 1.05x baseline. Customer AC-998 reports degraded but usable.

michael: paging update to oncall: I'm going to notify support and legal of degraded SLA for AC-998; Emily can you draft the incident summary?

emily: on it. Draft: "We experienced routing misconfiguration after a schema change which caused a fallback to an unavailable model variant and cross-region oscillation. Impacted requests: ~43k in 10m window. Error rate peaked at 8%. We applied temporary override pinning variant, disabled cross-region fallback, and deployed a schema-compatibility patch. Continuing monitoring."

carol: can we confirm config-service decoders now translate `variant_preference` -> `preferred_variant`? Tom, logs?

@tom: canary logs: `INFO alias mapping: variant_preference -> preferred_variant applied for 1 request`. Pushing patch to prod now. Command: `deploy config-service v3.12.1`

infra-bot: deploy v3.12.1 started. Rolling update across 6 replicas.

michael: I'll keep the routing override active for 30m post-deploy to ensure no regression.

sarah: running smoke tests against top 10 customers. All responses correct for pinned routes.

emily: support: AC-998 acknowledges mitigation, asked for root cause and ETA. I told them preliminary ETA for full resolution 30m and will follow up with postmortem.

dave: once config-service is fully rolled we should re-enable region-fallback with a guard: add `min-healthy-capacity` check so we don't fallback if variant not available in region.

carol: agree. Also add lint rule to schema repo to fail CI if deprecated keys are removed without migration doc. I'll open PR with tests.

infra-bot: deploy v3.12.1 completed. All replicas healthy.

michael: removing temporary region-fallback=false for smart-router now? Or wait for safer guards?

tom: wait 10m. I'll enable region-fallback with `min-healthy-capacity=2` after verification.

emily: 10m after enabling small-scale: enabling region-fallback with min-healthy-capacity=2. Command:``` 
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/smart-router REGION_FALLBACK=true MIN_HEALTHY_CAPACITY=2 --record
```

infra-bot: flags applied.

emily: monitoring post-enable: no oscillation for 20m, errors stable at 0.6% (close to baseline), latency normalizing.

michael: great. I'll close the pager after handoff. Tom, please pick up postmortem owner?

@tom: I'll own the postmortem and coordinate with Carol for schema-linting PR and with Support for customer comms.

sarah: lessons: 1) don't drop deprecated keys without compatibility mapping 2) default fallback should be safe cross-region 3) guard region-fallback with availability checks. Add these to postmortem template.

emily: customer comms ready. I'll send preliminary note to AC-998 and update support ticket.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged. Pager closed at 2487663600 after mitigation and monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident timeline summary: root at 2487659999, mitigations applied (override, disable fallback, schema patch), rollback not required. Postmortem owner: tom.

michael: thanks team. I'll add incident to incidents backlog and schedule 1h follow-up review at 2487667200.

carol: I'll open PR for schema-lint and default-fallback changes now.

sarah: marking thread resolved in 2h unless regressions. Good work everyone :thumbsup:

emily: adding notes to the support ticket and sending customer follow-up.

tom: closing handoff to postmortem.
